# ppds_forms_publish

Publish ALL pending customizations for the selected table, including changes beyond the selected form. Requires confirmPublishEntity equal to the table logical name. Verifies only the selected form after entity-scoped publication.

## Input schema

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| entityLogicalName | `String` | yes |  |
| formId | `Guid` | yes |  |
| expectedDraftHash | `String` | yes |  |
| confirmPublishEntity | `String` | yes | Exact table logical name acknowledging table-wide publication |
| confirmEnvironment | `String` | no |  |

## Output

Returns `Task<FormAuthoringResult>`.
